item.title: 2021 Maserati Levante S
item.description: This 2021 Maserati Levante S was specified in Blu Emozione over Nero leather upholstery, and it was optioned with the GT Sport Nerissimo Pack. item.title: Supercharged 427-Powered 1968 Ford Mustang GT500CR 900S 6-Speed by Classic Recreations
item.description: This 1968 Mustang began as a C-code coupe, and it was rebuilt by Classic Recreations with their GT500CR package. item.title: One-Owner 2005 Ford GT
item.description: This 2005 Ford GT is one of 2,022 built for the model year and was purchased new by the seller from Montavon Motors in Grand Rapids, Michigan. It is powered by a supercharged 5.4-liter V8 linked with a six-speed manual gearbox and a helical limited-slip differential. item.title: 1969 Ferrari 365 GT 2+2
item.description: This 1969 Ferrari 365 GT 2+2 is one of approximately 800 examples built over a three-year production run. Chassis 12665 underwent a repaint in black as part of a cosmetic refurbishment completed under previous ownership. It was later sold on BaT in February 2022 and then again on the site in June 2023.
